free_tier.stated: Pay-as-you-go with 'Free credits equivalent to 5 hours of Reverb ASR (free credits can be used for all products)'. Reverb Transcription is USD 0.20 an hour, so the grant is USD 1.00 of usage: 5 hours of Reverb English, or 200 minutes of Whisper Large at USD 0.005 a minute, or 333 minutes of Forced Alignment at USD 0.003 a minute.

chaining: five hours of Reverb is enough to transcribe a small corpus once and no more; the interesting composition is the 15-second minimum, which on a folder of short clips burns the credit on silence. What breaks: the grant is denominated in hours of one model, and a second pass with a different model spends it again.

limits.value: USD 1.00 of credit is the whole allowance: five hours of the cheapest English model, or three hours twenty minutes if the work needs Whisper Large, and nothing renews.
